def orange_pos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def player_pos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def bframe_pos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B':
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
print("BEFORE: O",orange_pos(current_frame),"B",bframe_pos(current_frame),"P",player_pos(current_frame))
r = action(['UP'], intent='explore')
print("after UP: O",orange_pos(current_frame),"B",bframe_pos(current_frame),"P",player_pos(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
